question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"specialized."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Specialized'** means having a particular area of expertise or skill. (विशेष प्रयोजन से प्रयुक्त, (किसी क्षेत्र-विशेष में) विशेषज्ञता प्राप्‍त) • **Example**: *Her job is very **specialized**__.* • The sentence implies that the blank needs a word that describes cells that have a specific function. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct passage: The automobile industry is one of the __leading__ industries at the global level. It plays a crucial role in the development of the global economy because of the high revenues and increased customer demands. The automobile industry helps to __foster__ economic development of the country; therefore, it is widely recognised as a major economic sector. The automobile industry consists of multiple companies __**specialised**__ in car manufacturing, as well as the ones involved in marketing and distribution of automobile products, such as cars, buses, vans, trucks, motorcycles, mopeds and ______ (4) ________ bicycles. The global automobile industry incorporates several large car manufacturers' blocs that work ______ (5) ______ at the global level. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: 'Unspecialized' **means not having a specific area of expertise or skill. (अविशिष्ट) • **Option 3: 'Simplified'** means made simpler or easier to understand. (किसी काम या बात को सुकर या सुबोध बनाना; किसी चीज़ की जटिलता को कम करना, उसे सरल बनाना) • **Option 4: 'Non-simplified' **means not simple. (गैर सरलीकृत) 40:Taed, The correct answer is** "motorized".**
